releaseNotes:
Health & Hygiene Report 0.1.5 completes the final UI and workflow refinement release.

- Simplifies Inspection Details and improves Findings Review.
- Adds safe deletion support for manually added Pending Findings.
- Improves Responsible Department classification.
- Refines the compact Corrective Actions workflow and Before/After evidence management.
- Refreshes the application icon.
- Clarifies About/Updates information and Device Activation controls.
